lines.text: Many learners say: I am here since Monday.
Better: I have been here since Monday.
Have been! I have been here since 2015.

data.right: I have been here since Monday.

quiz.stem: I live here. It is 2020 now. I ___ here since 2015.

native.tip: En français, « Je suis là depuis lundi » se dit au présent. En anglais, avec “since”, il faut “have been”.
native.caption: Vous dites “I am here since Monday.” ? En français, on dit « je suis là depuis lundi » au présent. En anglais, avec “since”, employez “have been”. Dites plutôt “I have been here since Monday.” — écoutez Carlos et répétez avec lui ! Plus d’exercices dans l’appli Lexkite.

en.tip: French uses the present here, but English does not. With “since”, say “have been”.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I am here since Monday.” French uses the present here, but English does not. With “since”, say “have been”. Say “I have been here since Monday.” Listen to Carlos and repeat with him! More exercises in the Lexkite app.
